description.en:
Our upright steam mops clean and sanitize hard floors with high-temperature steam — no chemicals needed. The lightweight design glides effortlessly while delivering powerful steam for streak-free results.

Features include 30-second heat-up, 1500W power, adjustable steam control, washable microfiber pads, and a 5-meter cord for large rooms. The swivel head reaches under furniture with ease, and the dual water tank allows continuous use.

We support OEM/ODM services: custom colors, branding, and packaging. MOQ 300 units, production lead time 25-35 days.
description.zh:
我们的立式蒸汽拖把利用高温蒸汽清洁和消毒硬质地板，无需化学清洁剂。轻量化设计轻松滑行，强劲蒸汽带来无水痕效果。

功能包括30秒加热、1500W功率、可调蒸汽控制、可水洗超细纤维拖布和5米电源线。旋转头轻松深入家具底部，双水箱支持连续使用。

我们支持OEM/ODM服务：定制颜色、品牌和包装。最小起订量300台，大货交期25-35天。
